items.difficulty_reason: Let f : X -> Y be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes and let a be the right adjoint of Rf_* from Lemma labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image; the lemma asserts that a maps D^+_QCoh(O_Y) into D^+_QCoh(O_X) and, more precisely, that there is an integer N such that H^i(K) = 0 for i <= c implies H^i(a(K)) = 0 for i <= c - N (statement lines 725-733). The proof uses Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-image to see that Rf_* has finite cohomological dimension, i.e. that some N gives H^i(Rf_*L) = 0 for i >= N + c whenever H^i(L) = 0 for i >= c, and then for K with H^i(K) = 0 for i <= c computes Hom(tau_{<= c - N}a(K), a(K)) = Hom(Rf_*tau_{<= c - N}a(K), K) = 0, which forces the vanishing of H^i(a(K)) for i <= c - N (proof lines 735-749). Converting finite cohomological dimension of Rf_* into a bound on the cohomological amplitude of a via the Hom-vanishing form of adjunction is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
